# YPAC POS & KUBE Store

Welcome to the KUBE YPAC Store. A system built to support disabled students in Semarang YPAC by selling their handicrafts, cookies, and creative products.

## Routes
- / (Home Page)
- /produk (Product Catalog)
- /produk/{slug} (Product details)
- /tentang-kami (About Us)
- /hubungi-kami (Contact Us)
